title: potentilla cinerea subsp. arenaria
intro: Potentilla cinerea subsp. arenaria, commonly known as Silver Buffaloberry, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is used as a medicinal plant, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla cinerea subsp. arenaria include its ability to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
